metadata.description: Resume, cover letter and job application tools for Cursor, via the ResumeNext MCP servers.

plugins.name: resumenext-ats-resume-checker
plugins.description: Get your resume's ATS score out of 100, the issues to fix first, and a link that opens it in the ResumeNext resume builder. No sign-in.

plugins.name: resumenext-job-match
plugins.description: Compare your resume with a job post: matched and missing keywords, coverage, a job-tailored ATS score, and an editable copy with the job attached. No sign-in.

plugins.name: resumenext-cover-letter
plugins.description: Score your cover letter out of 100 against a fixed checklist, read example letters for your role, and open the final letter in the ResumeNext cover letter editor. No sign-in.

plugins.name: resumenext-resignation-letter
plugins.description: Get a resignation letter in a standard, formal or grateful style from your company and last day, ready to edit and save as PDF, DOCX or TXT in ResumeNext. No sign-in.

plugins.name: resumenext-linkedin-resume
plugins.description: Score your LinkedIn profile out of 100 for the role you want, see what to fix first, and turn it into a resume that opens in the ResumeNext editor. No sign-in.

plugins.name: resumenext-resume-examples
plugins.description: Find resume examples for your role and the right resume template for your profile, each opening in the ResumeNext editor as a starting point. No sign-in.

plugins.name: resumenext-resume-bullet-points
plugins.description: Check resume bullet points line by line for action verbs, numbers, first person and phrases to delete, and get action verbs by type of work. No sign-in.

plugins.name: resumenext-resume-skills
plugins.description: Get the skills recruiters expect for your role and see which ones your resume lists and shows in your work, lists only, shows only, or misses. No sign-in.
